cards.title: Ten bookkeeping tables
items: tenant, app_user, broker_profile, queue_ref, capture_rule, replay_job, operation_audit, operation_payload, operation_intent and idempotency_key stay in SQLite.
Recovery and audit remain available when the optional message store is absent.

cards.title: Three traffic tables
items: message_capture, message_rollup and capture_dedupe share the adopter's message database.
The dedupe ledger commits with each capture batch so redelivery cannot double-count.

cards.title: Store boundary
items: Identifiers copied into the message store are logical references; a database foreign key cannot cross from PostgreSQL to SQLite.
Bodies above 64 KB may spill to an adopter-owned object store; message_capture keeps payload_ref.
No database schema has been applied; the diagram shows the documented design.
